cards.back: Something that is alive. It moves, grows, feeds and has young.
cards.say: living thing. Something that is alive. It moves, grows, feeds and has young.

cards.back: Something in food that your body needs to live and grow.
cards.say: nutrient. Something in food that your body needs to live and grow.

cards.back: To start to grow from a seed.
cards.say: germinate. To start to grow from a seed.

cards.back: All the bones in a body.
cards.say: skeleton. All the bones in a body.

cards.back: A place where two bones meet.
cards.say: joint. A place where two bones meet.

cards.back: A body part that pulls on bones to make them move.
cards.say: muscle. A body part that pulls on bones to make them move.

cards.back: A push or a pull.
cards.say: force. A push or a pull.

cards.back: A force between surfaces that rub together. It slows things down.
cards.say: friction. A force between surfaces that rub together. It slows things down.

cards.back: A force that pulls things towards the ground.
cards.say: gravity. A force that pulls things towards the ground.

cards.back: An object that attracts iron and steel.
cards.say: magnet. An object that attracts iron and steel.

cards.back: The end of a magnet where its pull is strongest.
cards.say: pole. The end of a magnet where its pull is strongest.

cards.back: What an object is made from.
cards.say: material. What an object is made from.

cards.back: Lets light pass through so you can see clearly.
cards.say: transparent. Lets light pass through so you can see clearly.

cards.back: Does not let any light through.
cards.say: opaque. Does not let any light through.

cards.back: Something that gives out its own light, such as the Sun.
cards.say: light source. Something that gives out its own light, such as the Sun.

cards.back: A dark shape made when an object blocks light.
cards.say: shadow. A dark shape made when an object blocks light.

cards.back: To bounce back, like light from a mirror.
cards.say: reflect. To bounce back, like light from a mirror.

cards.back: The remains or marks of a living thing that died long ago, kept in rock.
cards.say: fossil. The remains or marks of a living thing that died long ago, kept in rock.

cards.back: A mixture of tiny pieces of rock and rotted plants and animals.
cards.say: soil. A mixture of tiny pieces of rock and rotted plants and animals.

cards.back: Lets water soak through it.
cards.say: permeable. Lets water soak through it.

cards.back: Soaks up liquid.
cards.say: absorbent. Soaks up liquid.

cards.back: Does not let water through.
cards.say: waterproof. Does not let water through.

cards.back: Bends easily without breaking.
cards.say: flexible. Bends easily without breaking.

cards.back: Keeping clean so you stay well.
cards.say: hygiene. Keeping clean so you stay well.

cards.back: Eating the right amount of each food group.
cards.say: balanced diet. Eating the right amount of each food group.
